idea-plugin.name: Prompt Library
idea-plugin.description:
A simple and efficient prompt library for JetBrains Rider that helps you organize, search, and reuse text prompts.
Features: • Create, edit, and delete prompts with confirmation • Click any prompt to copy it to clipboard • Real-time search with case-insensitive filtering • Import/Export prompts as JSON (supports simple string arrays) • Automatic duplicate detection and prevention • Persistent storage - prompts survive IDE restarts • Clean, responsive UI that adapts to light/dark themes
